text_block_list.text: —The time for the decisive battle has come.

Narita Top Road firmly tightens her lips
and straightens her posture.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —I'm fine.

If that is the case, I have nothing more to say.
I have done what needed to be done, and entrusted all that needed to be entrusted.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a good time today,
Ayabe-san, Opera O-chan.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Win or lose, this is the grand finale of the Classic Triple Crown. Let's make it spectacular.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I believe in it. If I run with all my might,
I can bring brilliance to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: To everyone... radiance...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You haven't given up, have you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. I might not be a unique Umamusume
like Ayabe-san or Opera O-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I don't believe I can't shine.
I want to show my own ideal.
Yes, that any Umamusume—”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: As long as you believe, you can keep going anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't want anyone thinking that coming to an end is the right thing.
Not even you, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san. You might not know this, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, you're the one who saved me back during the Junior Class, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I paid no heed to my injuries and simply couldn't stop reckless training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the current Ayabe-san...
I have to surpass this running...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't reach the summit. Nor could I...
live up to the expectations of everyone supporting me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I finally realized. She isn't an opponent
I can catch up to through reckless determination alone...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Without running out of steam,
I want to keep up... No matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I won't forget what I learned back then...
So this time, it's my turn to—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll lend a hand, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We have a future. We really do.
Both for me, and for Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I will prove it――with my running!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san... You...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, precisely! Everyone must
pave their own path and take pride in it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I too shall walk it. A path untrodden,
which no soloist has ever walked before.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A never-ending... road...
Something like that is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be forgiven. I cannot accept it.
That is why—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win this Kikuka Sho, no matter what.
It's the culmination of the Classic Triple Crown
I've poured everything into! And—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(What's being tested is—our bond.
Meeting Trainer and Ayabe-san has made me stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Umamusume can grow, they can overcome anything.
Through the power of bonds!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Just like I did, Ayabe-san can overcome it too.
I'll prove it to her!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Now, let us go—upon the path to the summit!
